# Tauri v2 index — router to 30+ Tauri sub-skills

Curated by Skill Harbor — @full-stack-skills' Tauri index: a router skill that acts as the primary entry point for any Tauri work. It maps intent to 30+ specialized sub-skills — planning and architecture, core lifecycle (setup, scaffold, develop, updater, mobile), system integration (shell, clipboard, dialog, notifications, global shortcuts, autostart, biometric, deep linking), data and networking (HTTP client, WebSocket, upload, SQL, store, stronghold secrets, file system), and window and UI (menus, system tray, window state, single instance) — each carrying its own local `examples/` and `templates/` (e.g. capabilities JSON) so the agent works offline-ready without expensive network searches. Honest caveats: an index only — it routes to sub-skills rather than teaching the topic itself, so the sub-skill content must actually be present in the install; written for Tauri v2.0+ (plugins, capabilities, permissions). Apache-2.0 licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
